summary: R2 (WARP-0502, warp run wrapper) is correct and honest. Independent adversarial review pass_with_notes, 0 blocking; gate GREEN (selftest 817 after landing). An optional default-off observer streams a driven run's live loop progress into the R1 registry (started, per-phase step, heartbeat, block on a human pause, terminal done/aborted) while leaving the executor byte-identical when unobserved and never leaking high-volume progress into the committed event stream; three mutations proven to turn the selftest red. executor_run_observer mechanical is honest (registry emission gate-tested over a fake seam); build/review/approve stay delegated. proof_digest via validate.py.
